senses.gloss:
CLOAK (subs.):
(1) कञ्चुकः,
her body covered with
a blue c. hanging down to the ankle:
आगुल्फावल-
म्बिना नीलकञ्चुकेनाच्छन्नशरीराम्, K.;
(2) प्रावारः
(gen. = blanket or shawl), Mr.

CLOAK (v.): अवगुण्ठयति (गुण्ठ्, c. 10): v. To
hide, palliate.
CLOCKWORK: घटीयन्त्रम्।
CLODHOPPER: v. Clown.

CLOISTER:
I A portico: q. v.
II A monas-
-tery: q. v.: विहारः।
CLOISTRAL: v. Monastic.

CLOSE (v. t.):
I To shut: q. v.: अपि-दधाति
(धा, c. 3),
c. the back door:
पिधेहि पक्षद्वारकम्,
Mr.;
to c. the eyes:
लोचने मीलयति, नि-, (c. of
मोल्), Me.
II To bring into contact: संहन्ति
(हन्, c. 2).
III To conclude, finish: q. v.:
समापयति (c. of आप्).
IV To confine: q. v.
To c. in or round:
परिवृणोतिः v. To surround.

CLOSE (v. i.):
I To come together:
(1) नि-
मीलति (मील्, c. l) (of the eye);
(2) समा-
रोहति (रुह्, c. l) (of wounds).: v. To unite.
II To come to an end: expr. by अवसितः
(ता, तं), समाप्तः (प्ता, प्तं), etc.; when he c. d:
वचस्यवसिते तस्मिन्, Ku.

CLOSE (adj.):
I Shut fast:
(1) पिहितः (ता,
 तं);
(2) संवृतः (ता, तं);
(3) बद्धः (द्धा, द्धं)
(=bound).
II Secret, retired: q. v.:
विविक्तः (क्ता, क्तं).
III Confined, as air: निरुद्धः
(द्धा, द्धं).
IV Reticent, taciturn: q. v. V.
Niggardly: q. v.: बद्धमुष्टि (mfn.).
VI Dense,
compact: q. v.: घनः (ना, नं).
VII Ad-
-joining, near: q. v.: सन्निहितः (ता, तं),
are
always c. at hand:
हस्ते नित्यसान्निध्यानि, D.
VIII
Of style: v. Concise.
IX Intimate:
(1)
घनः (ना, नं);
(2) निविडः (डा, डं),
very c.
friendship:
निविडतमा मैत्री, Bha.
X Accurate,
careful: q. v.

CLOSE (adv.):
I Densely: q. v.
II Near:
q. v.:
(1) उपान्ते;
(2) समीपतः।

CLOSE (subs.):
I An enclosure: q. v.: वृतिः।
II
End, termination: q. v.: अवसानम्,
c. of the
day:
दिवावसानम्, R.
III Junction: q. v.

CLOSE ON or UPON: स्थिरीकरोतिः v. Agree,
decide.
CLOSE UP: अवृणोति (वृ, c. 5): v. To block up.

CLOSE WITH:
I To close on: q. v.
II To unite
with: q. v.
III To grapple with: संगच्छति
(गम्, c. 4), समेति (इ, c. 2), etc.

CLOSE-FISTED, CLOSE-HANDED: बद्धमुष्टि (mfn.),
your c. ness in giving me a look:
दृष्टिदाने तव बद्ध-
मुष्टिता, N.

CLOSELY: v. Densely; nearly; strictly;
accurately; firmly; secretly.

CLOSENESS:
I Compact: q. v.: घनता।
II
Nearness: q. v.: नैकट्यम्।
III Niggardliness:
q. v.
IV Of air: निरुद्धवातता। V. Of style:
v. Conciseness.
VI Narrowness: q. v.
VII Accuracy: q. v.
VIII Secrecy: q. v.
CLOSE-STOOL: *उपशयनपीठम्; विण्मूत्राधारः।
CLOSET (subs.): कोष्ठः।

CLOSET (v.):
I To conceal: q. v.
II To
consult: q. v.
CLOT (v. t.): पिण्ड (mn.).

CLOT (v.):
(1) पिण्डीभवति;
(2) घनीभवति।
C. ted
hair:
जटा, -जूटः।

CLOTH:
I Lit.:
(1) वस्त्रम्,
coarse c.
स्थूलवस्त्रम्,
P. ii. 5.;
fine c.:
सूक्ष्मवस्त्रम्, N. com.;
(2)
पटः
or
पट्टः,
making of different kinds of c.:
अनेक-
विधपटरचना, P. ii. 5.: v. Also clothes.
II A
profession: q. v.

CLOTHE (v.):
I To put on c. s:
c. ing her-
self:
गृहीतवस्त्रा, Ku.;
c. ing himself:
परिधाय
 वाससी, K.: v. To put on clothes.
II To
invest with raiment: वस्त्रं etc. परिधापयति (c.
of धा)
or
वासयति (c. of वस्).
III To pro-
-vide with c. s: but should feed and c. her:
ग्रासाच्छादनन्तु देयमेव, K. b.
IV To cover or
invest: q. v.

CLOTHES, CLOTHING:
(1) वसनम्, when (her)
c.
were being drawn off:
आकृष्यमाणे वसने, Mah.;
(2) वस्त्रम्,
taking off c.:
वस्त्राणि मोचयित्वा, P.;
(3) वासस् (n.),
Basantasenā's c. are wet:
क्लिन्ने
 वाससी वसन्तसेनायाः, Mr.;
(4) अंशुकम्;
(5)
अम्बरम् (rare);
(6) परिच्छदः,
pretty c.
कमनीयपरि-
च्छदः, Ki.;
(7) परिधानम् (=under-c.),
by whom
even her c. was taken away:
येनास्याः परिधानमप्य-
पहृतम्, Ve. N.B. The first five words gen. = a
single piece of cloth and their dual is often
used to denote a suit of c. as the Hindu's
dress consisted only of two pieces of gar-
-ment: v. Dress.

CLOTHIER:
(1) पट-
or
पट्टकारः (maker);
(2)
वस्त्रविक्रेतृ (m.) (seller).

CLOUDED:
I Lit: मेघावृतः (ता, तं);
(2) मेघा-
च्छन्नः (न्ना, न्नं);
(3) घनोपरुद्धः (द्धा, द्धं).
II
Fig. v. Dark, gloomy, sullen.

CLOUDY:
I Lit., clouded: q. v.:
(1) अम्रितः
(ता, तं), R. iii. 12;
(2) साभ्रः (f. भ्रा), Me.
ii. 29. Ph.
c. weather
दुर्दिनम्।
II Fig., dark,
obscure: q. v.: तमोवृतः (ता, तं).
CLOUT: चीरम्: v. Patch.

CLOVE:
I The plant: लवङ्गः।
II The fruit:
लवङ्गम्।

CLOVEN:
(1) स्फाटितः (ता, तं);
(2) दीर्णः, वि-,
(र्णा, र्णं);
(3) खण्डितः (ता, तं). C.-hoofed:
द्विशफः (फा, फम्).
C.-tongued:
द्विजिह्वः (ह्वा, ह्वं)
(=double-tongued), Śi.

CLOVER: त्रिपर्णी (?). To live in c. i. e. luxurious-
ly: q. v.

CLOWN:
I A countryman:
(1) ग्रामिकः;
(2)
ग्राम्यजनः;
(3) कृषीवलः (=agriculturist).
II A
buffoon: q. v.: भण्डः।

CLOWNISH:
(1) ग्राम्यः (म्या, म्यं);
(2) अशिष्टः
(ष्टा, ष्टं) (not polite.).

CLOY (v.): सं-तर्पयति (c. of तृप्): v. To sati-
-ate.
